text:
Avery (CS): Quick pulse — we need to lock a weekly 60m 'Onboard Clinic' cadence to support ramping customers (runbook + hands-on troubleshooting). Candidates: Tue 09:00 UTC, Wed 16:00 UTC, Fri 02:00 UTC. Who can host/cover and any constraints? We also want a short feedback capture and a 5-min renewal health check in the agenda.

Priya: Tue 09:00 UTC works for me. Happy to co-host first two.

Tom: Tue 09 is good. I can take the infra/runbook section (SRE checklist + ded migration notes).

Jules: Wed 16:00 UTC suits EMEA best but I can rotate. If we want max attendance Tue 09 might be better for APAC/EMEA overlap.

Priya: +1 for rotating hosts. Keeps it fresh and spreads context.

Onboarding Bot: auto: agenda template created -> paste below for copy/paste
```
30m — onboarding runbook walkthrough (templates, infra checks)
15m — live troubleshooting & demo (bring a customer case)
5m  — renewal/health quick triage (red/yellow/green + owner)
5m  — feedback & NPS link + action items
```

Maya (PE): Add a 1–2 prompt fidelity check at the end (tiny eval) so we can detect quality regressions tied to recent model/quant changes. If it falls below threshold, it should create a ticket in Optimize.

Avery (CS): Love that — will add a 2-min micro-eval block and link to the evaluation form. @Jules can you own follow-ups and the action item tracker in Notion? :point_right: :spiral_notepad:

Jules: Yep I can own follow-ups. Proposal: rotate hosts every 3 weeks so no single person gets burned out.

Priya: I can host week 1, Tom week 2, Jules week 3 as a starter rotation.

Tom: Ack — will prepare the SRE checklist and a short troubleshooting repo snippet to paste into the chat.

Avery (CS): I'll schedule the first three sessions on Tue 09:00 UTC: 4/8, 4/15, 4/22 (calendar invites + Zoom). Will attach the runbook, the micro-eval, and the feedback form to the invite.

Onboarding Bot: auto: calendar events created for attendees + placeholder recording link.

Maya (PE): Also suggest we tag "renewal-risk" in the post-session notes when a customer scores yellow/red so AMs can follow up within 48h.

Avery (CS): Agreed. I'll create a workflow: yellow -> AM ping, red -> AM + CS lead sync within 24h. I'll add it to the Notion checklist and to the calendar description.

Jules: Small ask — can we include a single slide that shows per-model latency/cost knobs for customers so we can recommend quick wins during the clinic?

Tom: I have a short snippet and a table (quantization options + perf delta) I can attach.

Priya: Great — once calendar is up I'll drop it in this thread and link the feedback form.

Avery (CS): Thanks everyone. Next steps: I schedule invites, @Jules owns follow-ups, @Tom uploads infra snippet, @Maya wires the eval triggers with Optimize, @Priya helps host first week. See you in the first clinic — will post the Notion link in this thread shortly. :tada:
